info.name: Pinpoint
info.summary: Extract fields from invoices and receipts into Tables, with every value pinned to its source
info.description:
Pinpoint reads invoices, receipts and other documents in your Files and fills a row in [Tables](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/tables) for each one. Every value shows exactly where it was found: the page, the highlighted spot and the text it was read from.
**Why it is different**
- **Every value is checked against the document.** The language model must quote the text it read each value from. Pinpoint looks that quote up in the document's own text and only marks a value *verified* when the document literally says it. Values the model could not point to are marked *not found* instead of being presented as fact. - **Your table is the schema.** Pick a table, and its columns are what Pinpoint extracts. Column descriptions tell the model what to look for. Or start from the invoice and receipt templates. - **Sums and dates are cross-checked.** Net + tax must equal the total, the due date cannot be before the issue date. When a check fails, the values involved go to review. - **A person approves before anything is saved.** The review screen puts each value next to its highlighted source. The row written to Tables keeps a link to the file and the evidence for each value. - **Your AI, your server.** Pinpoint has no model of its own: it uses the text generation provider your admin configured in Nextcloud (for example the local [llm2](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/llm2), LocalAI or Ollama). Scans and photos are read with Tesseract inside the app's container. - **Works with the Assistant.** Pinpoint adds an "Extract fields from a document" task to the Nextcloud Assistant.
**Requirements**: [AppAPI](https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/latest/admin_manual/exapps_management/AppAPIAndExternalApps.html) with a deploy daemon (HaRP), the Tables app, and a text generation provider (Administration → Artificial intelligence).
**Data**: Document text is sent to the text generation provider configured on your Nextcloud. Pinpoint stores extracted values waiting for review inside its container for a configurable number of days and keeps no copies of your files.
